display_name: Amir Khusrau & Vira Pandya (Pandya War Arc)
one_line: Court poet Amir Khusrau and prince Vira Pandya, facing the 1311 Delhi intervention in the Pandya succession crisis.

appearance.age_look: Amir Khusrau appears as a lean man in his late 30s; Vira Pandya as a broad-shouldered warrior in his early 20s.
appearance.face: Amir Khusrau has an oval face, wheatish North Indian complexion, sharp nose, thin mustache and thoughtful, intense eyes with a calm, observant expression; Vira Pandya has a square jaw, medium-dark South Indian complexion, strong nose, thick brows, a short trimmed beard and a determined, defiant gaze.
appearance.hair: Amir Khusrau’s black hair is shoulder-length, slightly wavy, tucked neatly under a simple off-white quilted cap with a narrow brown band; Vira Pandya’s black hair is tied in a high warrior’s knot at the back of his head, front kept tidy with a small gold forehead plaque fixed to a dark red cloth band.
appearance.costume: Amir Khusrau wears a long, straight Delhi-style quilted jama reaching mid-calf in muted light beige with fine vertical stitch lines, tied with a narrow brown leather belt, over slim dark brown trousers and soft dark brown leather shoes; a simple off-white shawl is draped around his shoulders and he carries a small dark brown leather satchel at his left hip. Vira Pandya wears a South Indian royal-warrior outfit: a fitted short-sleeved cotton tunic in deep maroon that reaches mid-thigh, over cream-colored dhoti trousers wrapped snugly for movement, with a broad gold-bordered dark red cloth belt knotted at the front; over his tunic he has a steel breastplate shaped to the torso, realistically simple with minimal edging, and matching steel arm-guards on his forearms. He wears multiple gold necklaces, a pair of gold armlets on his upper arms, and small gold stud earrings. His feet are in dark brown leather sandals with straps around the ankles.
appearance.signature: Amir Khusrau carries a rolled manuscript and a simple wooden writing tablet tucked under his left arm; Vira Pandya wields a realistic South Indian straight sword with a gently tapering steel blade and a plain bronze hilt, held in his right hand, with a scabbard hanging from his belt on his left side.

ref_desc: Amir Khusrau is a lean, wheatish-complexioned man in a light beige quilted jama with brown belt, off-white shawl, cap and manuscript, beside broad-shouldered Vira Pandya in deep maroon tunic, cream dhoti, steel breastplate, gold ornaments and dark red belt wielding a bronze-hilted steel sword.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of two historically grounded characters from 1311 CE South India: Amir Khusrau, a lean North Indian man with an oval wheatish face, thin mustache and thoughtful eyes, wearing a light beige quilted jama to mid-calf with fine vertical stitching, narrow brown leather belt, slim dark brown trousers, soft dark brown leather shoes, simple off-white shawl around his shoulders, and an off-white quilted cap with a narrow brown band, carrying a rolled manuscript and a wooden writing tablet at his left arm; and beside him Vira Pandya, a broad-shouldered South Indian prince with a square jaw, medium-dark complexion, short trimmed beard, strong brows and a defiant gaze, hair tied in a high warrior’s knot with a small gold forehead plaque on a dark red band, dressed in a deep maroon short-sleeved tunic to mid-thigh, cream dhoti trousers wrapped close for movement, a broad dark red belt with gold border, realistic steel breastplate and matching forearm guards, dark brown leather sandals, layered gold necklaces, gold armlets and small gold stud earrings, holding a straight steel South Indian sword with a plain bronze hilt and scabbard at his belt; keep proportions shonen-anime energetic but ensure all garments, armour, and weapons are plausibly 14th-century and modest, and use a palette dominated by light beige, dark brown, deep maroon, dark red, steel grey and gold.
